q: Which solid has the lowest melting point?
Which solid is a metal? Give two reasons.
B: it conducts as a solid and has a high melting point.
Classify A, C and D by structure.
A ionic (conducts only when melted or dissolved). C simple molecular (low melting point, no conduction). D giant covalent (very high melting point, no conduction).
D could be sand (silicon dioxide). Suggest why it is used in furnace linings.
Giant covalent: very high melting point and does not react or conduct, so it can withstand great heat.
